title: Representational and Functional Robustness to Electrode Montages in EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) are intended to generalize across different datasets by learning representations that, ideally, are invariant to dataset-specific EEG configurations such as electrode montages. However, EEG-FMs that accept different montages as input do not guarantee that representations and predictions remain stable across different electrode configurations, especially outside the training setting. In this work, we investigate the effects of different electrode montages through a joint functional and representational analysis of four EEG foundation models selected to span distinct montage-handling designs. We evaluate embeddings on cross-subject resting-state eyes-open/closed and within-subject motor-imagery classification under spatially informed channel reduction. translated_title: EEG基础模型对电极导联方案的表征与功能鲁棒性
translated_abstract: EEG基础模型（EEG-FMs）旨在通过学习理想情况下对数据集特定EEG配置（如电极导联方案）不变的表征，从而在不同数据集之间实现泛化。然而，接受不同导联方案作为输入的EEG基础模型并不能保证其表征和预测在不同电极配置下保持稳定，尤其是在训练设置之外。在本工作中，我们通过对四个EEG基础模型进行联合的功能与表征分析来研究不同电极导联方案的影响，这些模型的选择涵盖了不同的导联处理设计。我们在空间感知的通道缩减条件下，评估了模型嵌入在跨被试静息态睁眼/闭眼分类和被试内运动想象分类上的表现。功能鲁棒性通过线性探针在不同通道数量上的泛化能力进行测试，而表征鲁棒性则通过（原文此处截断）……进行评估。
tldr: 通过对四个EEG基础模型进行联合功能与表征分析，本研究揭示了它们在不同电极导联方案（尤其是训练设置之外）下表征与预测的稳定性难以保证。
en_tdlr: Through a joint functional and representational analysis of four EEG foundation models, this study reveals that their representations and predictions are not guaranteed to remain stable across different electrode montages, especially outside the training setting.
